    12	# The Čech kernel lemma and étale separatedness (ζ3 bricks K and the close)
    13	
    14	**The kernel lemma** (`AlgebraicGeometry.Over.exists_cechPic_map_snd_of_ker_whiskerLeft`):
    15	for a proper, geometrically irreducible and geometrically reduced curve `C` over `k` and
    16	a faithfully flat tower `A → B` of `k`-algebras, every Čech Picard class on
    17	`X_A = (C ⊗ Spec A).left` killed by the base-change pullback `cg^*` is pulled back from
    18	`Spec A`.  Route: extract a trivializing `0`-cochain `β` from the kernel hypothesis;
    19	produce the descent unit `w` (ζ3 brick W, `exists_kernelDescentUnit`); represent its
    20	descended class by a cover/cocycle/`μ` triple (ζ3 brick M, `descentClassRep`); glue and
    21	descend the cobounding units on an affine refinement (ζ3 brick G,
    22	`exists_kernelCobounding`); verify the coboundary relation by injectivity of `cg`-pullback
    23	and the `transition` field (`kernelCobounding_rel`); conclude by `mk_eq_mk_iff`.
    24	
    25	**The close** (`AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff.unit_injective`, Kleiman 2.5(1), axiom (C1)):
    26	the unit of the étale plus construction of the relative Picard functor is injective on
    27	every affine test algebra — the étale separatedness of `PicEtAff`.
    28	-/

    31	
    32	universe u

    10	theorem exists_cechPic_map_snd_of_ker_whiskerLeft
    11	    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
    12	    [Module.FaithfullyFlat A B]
    13	    (E : (XA).CechPic) (hE : Scheme.CechPic.map (cg) E = 1) :
    14	    ∃ M₁ : (SA).CechPic, Scheme.CechPic.map (pA) M₁ = E := by
    15	  classical
    16	  induction E using Scheme.CechPic.ind with | _ ℰ e
    17	  induction e using Quot.ind with | _ lam
    18	  rw [show (Quot.mk _ lam : (XA).unitsH1 ℰ)
    19	    = CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle.class lam from rfl] at hE ⊢
    20	  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := exists_trivializing_cochain C ℰ lam hE
    21	  obtain ⟨w, hwloc, hW⟩ := exists_kernelDescentUnit (C := C) ℰ lam (ℰ.pullback (cg))
    22	    (fun _ => le_rfl) β hβ
    23	  obtain ⟨𝒞, d, μ, hratio, htrans⟩ := descentClassRep (k := k) w hW

    26	      IsAffineOpen V ∧ s ∈ V ∧ V ≤ ℰ.opens s ⊓ (pA) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒞.opens ((pA).base s) := by

    28	    obtain ⟨V, hVaff, hsV, hVle⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp
    29	      (XA).isBasis_affineOpens
    30	      (show s ∈ ℰ.opens s ⊓ (pA) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒞.opens ((pA).base s) from
    31	        ⟨ℰ.mem_opens s, 𝒞.mem_opens ((pA).base s)⟩)
    32	    exact ⟨V, hVaff, hsV, hVle⟩
    33	  choose Uof hUaff hUmem hUle using haff
    34	  have hUE : ∀ s, Uof s ≤ ℰ.opens s := fun s => (hUle s).trans inf_le_left
    35	  have hUC : ∀ s, Uof s ≤ (pA) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒞.opens ((pA).base s) :=
    36	    fun s => (hUle s).trans inf_le_right
    37	  -- the cobounding units
    38	  choose c hc using fun s : XA =>
    39	    exists_kernelCobounding C ℰ lam β hβ 𝒞 μ w hwloc hratio
    40	      s (Uof s) (hUaff s) (hUE s) (hUC s)

    11	plus unfold `PicEtAff.unit_injective_of_ker`. -/
    12	theorem PicEtAff.unit_injective
    13	    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
    14	    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] :
    15	    Function.Injective (PicEtAff.unit C A) :=
    16	  PicEtAff.unit_injective_of_ker C A fun _ _ _ _ _ _ E hE =>
    17	    Over.exists_cechPic_map_snd_of_ker_whiskerLeft C E hE
    18	
    19	end close

1	structure BasicOpenCoverData [IsAffineHom π] : Type (u + 1) where
     2	  /-- The chart-0 index. -/
     3	  J₀ : Type u
     4	  /-- The chart-1 index. -/
     5	  J₁ : Type u
     6	  /-- The chart-0 index is finite. -/
     7	  fintype₀ : Fintype J₀
     8	  /-- The chart-1 index is finite. -/
     9	  fintype₁ : Fintype J₁
    10	  /-- The chart-0 basic-open generators. -/
    11	  h₀ : J₀ → Γ(relCurve C B, (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
    12	  /-- The chart-1 basic-open generators. -/
    13	  h₁ : J₁ → Γ(relCurve C B, (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
    14	  /-- The chart-0 partition coefficients. -/
    15	  a₀ : J₀ → Γ(relCurve C B, (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
    16	  /-- The chart-1 partition coefficients. -/
    17	  a₁ : J₁ → Γ(relCurve C B, (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
    18	  /-- The chart-0 partition witness. -/
    19	  partition₀ : ∑ j : J₀, a₀ j * h₀ j = 1
    20	  /-- The chart-1 partition witness. -/
    21	  partition₁ : ∑ j : J₁, a₁ j * h₁ j = 1
    22	
    23	attribute [instance] BasicOpenCoverData.fintype₀ BasicOpenCoverData.fintype₁
    24	
    25	namespace BasicOpenCoverData
    26	
    27	variable {C B π} [IsAffineHom π] (D : BasicOpenCoverData C B π)
    28	
    29	/-- The gluing index of the datum, `J = J₀ ⊕ J₁`. -/
    30	abbrev index : Type u := D.J₀ ⊕ D.J₁
    31	
    32	/-- The pieces of the datum: the basic opens `D(h_j)` of the two pinned charts. -/
    33	noncomputable def pieces : D.index → (relCurve C B).Opens :=
    34	  Sum.elim (fun j => (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.h₀ j))
    35	    (fun j => (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.h₁ j))
    36	
    37	@[simp]
    38	lemma pieces_inl (j : D.J₀) :
    39	    D.pieces (Sum.inl j) = (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.h₀ j) := rfl
    40	
    41	@[simp]
    42	lemma pieces_inr (j : D.J₁) :
    43	    D.pieces (Sum.inr j) = (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.h₁ j) := rfl

    46	lemma cover₀ : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ≤
    47	    ⨆ j : D.J₀, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.h₀ j) :=
    48	  le_iSup_basicOpen_of_sum_eq_one D.a₀ D.h₀ D.partition₀
    49	
    50	/-- The chart-1 pieces cover the pinned chart `V₁ᴮ`. -/
    51	lemma cover₁ : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤
    52	    ⨆ j : D.J₁, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.h₁ j) :=
    53	  le_iSup_basicOpen_of_sum_eq_one D.a₁ D.h₁ D.partition₁
    54	
    55	/-- The chart-0 generators, restricted to the overlap of the pinned charts. -/
    56	noncomputable def hInf (j : D.J₀) :
    57	    Γ(relCurve C B,
    58	      (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁) :=
    59	  (relCurve C B).resHom inf_le_left (D.h₀ j)
    60	
    61	/-- The restricted chart-0 pieces are subordinate to the pieces of the datum. -/
    62	lemma basicOpen_hInf_le (j : D.J₀) :
    63	    (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.hInf j) ≤ D.pieces (Sum.inl j) := by
    64	  rw [hInf, Scheme.basicOpen_resHom, pieces_inl]
    65	  exact inf_le_right

    68	partition witness restricts to a partition witness). -/
    69	lemma coverInf : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁
    70	    ≤ ⨆ j : D.J₀, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.hInf j) := by
    71	  refine le_iSup_basicOpen_of_sum_eq_one
    72	    (fun j => (relCurve C B).resHom inf_le_left (D.a₀ j)) D.hInf ?_
    73	  have hres := congrArg
    74	    ((relCurve C B).resHom (inf_le_left : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
    75	      (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀))
    76	    D.partition₀
    77	  rw [map_sum, map_one] at hres
    78	  rw [← hres]
    79	  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => (map_mul _ _ _).symm

    84	cover data of the two pinned charts together with transition units on the pairwise
    85	basic-open overlaps (with explicit inverse witnesses — `Units`) satisfying the cocycle

    87	normalization `g j j = 1`). This is the DAT-1 constructor input and the object RE-5

    89	structure BasicOpenCocycleDatum [IsAffineHom π] : Type (u + 1) extends
    90	    BasicOpenCoverData C B π where
    91	  /-- The transition units on the pairwise piece overlaps. -/

     2	variable (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
     3	variable (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite π]
     4	
     5	/-- **The whole-chart cover data**: the two pinned charts themselves, each presented as
     6	the basic open of `1` (partition of unity `1 · 1 = 1`). -/

     8	  J₀ := PUnit
     9	  J₁ := PUnit
    10	  fintype₀ := inferInstance
    11	  fintype₁ := inferInstance
    12	  h₀ _ := 1
    13	  h₁ _ := 1
    14	  a₀ _ := 1
    15	  a₁ _ := 1
    16	  partition₀ := by simp
    17	  partition₁ := by simp
    18	
    19	/-- The chart-0 piece is the whole first pinned chart. -/
    20	lemma thetaChartCover_pieces_inl (j : (thetaChartCover C B π).J₀) :
    21	    (thetaChartCover C B π).pieces (Sum.inl j) = (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ :=
    22	  (relCurve C B).basicOpen_of_isUnit isUnit_one
    23	
    24	/-- The chart-1 piece is the whole second pinned chart. -/
    25	lemma thetaChartCover_pieces_inr (j : (thetaChartCover C B π).J₁) :
    26	    (thetaChartCover C B π).pieces (Sum.inr j) = (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ :=
    27	  (relCurve C B).basicOpen_of_isUnit isUnit_one
    28	
    29	/-- Every piece is contained in its pinned chart, chart-0 side. -/
    30	lemma thetaChartCover_pieces_le_inl (j : (thetaChartCover C B π).J₀) :
    31	    (thetaChartCover C B π).pieces (Sum.inl j) ≤ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ :=
    32	  (thetaChartCover_pieces_inl C B π j).le
    33	
    34	/-- Every piece is contained in its pinned chart, chart-1 side. -/
    35	lemma thetaChartCover_pieces_le_inr (j : (thetaChartCover C B π).J₁) :
    36	    (thetaChartCover C B π).pieces (Sum.inr j) ≤ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ :=
    37	  (thetaChartCover_pieces_inr C B π j).le
    38	
    39	variable (a : ℕ)
    40	
    41	/-- **The whole-chart theta transition units**: `1` on the diagonal blocks, the relative
    42	theta cocycle `t₀ᵃ` (resp. its inverse) on the cross-chart blocks, restricted to the
    43	piece overlaps. -/
    44	noncomputable def thetaChartUnit :
    45	    ∀ i j : (thetaChartCover C B π).index,
    46	      Γ(relCurve C B,
    47	        (thetaChartCover C B π).pieces i ⊓ (thetaChartCover C B π).pieces j)ˣ
    48	  | Sum.inl _, Sum.inl _ => 1
    49	  | Sum.inl j, Sum.inr j' =>
    50	      (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict

For a scheme `C` over a field `k` (an object of `Over (Spec k)`) this file defines the
relative Picard functor of Grothendieck–Kleiman:
$$\operatorname{Pic}_{C/k}(T) \;=\; \operatorname{Pic}(C \times_k T)\,/\,
  \operatorname{Pic}(T),$$

along the second projection. The quotient — never the absolute `Pic(C ⊗ T)`, which is
not even a separated presheaf in any useful sense — is the functor that étale
sheafification and the representability theorem consume.

Products are the cartesian-monoidal product of `Over (Spec k)` (chosen pullbacks of
schemes): `C ⊗ T`, projection `snd C T`, whiskering `C ◁ g`, matching the vocabulary
of the challenge statement file.

## Main declarations

* `AlgebraicGeometry.picFromBase C T`: the subgroup of `(C ⊗ T).left.CechPic` of classes
  pulled back from `T` along the second projection.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.relPic C T`: the relative Picard group, the quotient by
  `picFromBase C T`, a `CommGroup`; `relPicMk` is the projection, with
  `relPicMk_eq_relPicMk_iff` the exact coset relation (a genuine range condition, no
  choice, no `Nonempty (≅)`).
* `AlgebraicGeometry.relPicMap C g`: restriction along `g : T' ⟶ T`, descended from
  pullback of Čech classes along `C ◁ g`.

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme (CechPic)

noncomputable section

/-- The subgroup of Picard classes on `C ⊗ T` pulled back from the test object `T`
along the second projection. The relative Picard group is the quotient by it. -/
def picFromBase (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : Subgroup ((C ⊗ T).left.CechPic) :=
  (CechPic.map (snd C T).left).range

modulo classes pulled back from `T`. -/

  (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic ⧸ picFromBase C T

281	    {F : (Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v}

330	/-- **Fibres of a group homomorphism translate onto the kernel.** For
331	`f : A →* B` and a base point `a₀`, dividing by `a₀` identifies the fibre of `f`
332	through `f a₀` with `ker f`. This is the normalisation step turning the fibre
333	description of the tangent space into the kernel description of Kleiman §5
334	Thm. 5.11. (Primed: mathlib's `MonoidHom.fiberEquivKer` states the same content
335	on the carriers `f ⁻¹' {f a} ≃ f.ker`; this variant is phrased on the *equation
336	subtypes* that `pointedDualNumberPointsEquivRepresentableFiber` produces.) -/
337	def MonoidHom.fiberEquivKer' {A : Type u} {B : Type v}
338	    [CommGroup A] [CommGroup B] (f : A →* B) (a₀ : A) :
339	    {a : A // f a = f a₀} ≃ {a : A // f a = 1} where
340	  toFun a := ⟨a.1 / a₀, by rw [map_div, a.2, div_self']⟩
341	  invFun a := ⟨a.1 * a₀, by rw [map_mul, a.2, one_mul]⟩
342	  left_inv a := Subtype.ext (by simp)
343	  right_inv a := Subtype.ext (by simp)

345	/-- **The tangent space of a representably group-valued functor, as a kernel**
346	(Kleiman §5 Thm. 5.11, representability leg). Let `G` be a `CommGrpCat`-valued
347	functor on `Over (Spec k)` whose set-valued shadow is represented by a
348	`k`-scheme `X`, and `e` a section of the structure morphism. Then `T_e X`
349	bijects with the **kernel** of the restriction homomorphism
350	`G(Spec k[ε]) →* G(Spec k)`.
351	
352	The fibre over the class of `e` is a coset of that kernel, because `e`'s own
353	class is hit by the *constant* tangent vector `augment ≫ e` — the retract-pair
354	identity `overDualNumberZero_comp_augment` is exactly what says so.
355	
356	⚠ This is a bijection of **sets**. It does not by itself transport `finrank`: a
357	bare `Equiv` does not determine dimension. The `k`-linearity bookkeeping is
358	deliberately *not* done here — under the w5-worksheet D6 scalar-identity-first
359	discipline it is done cocycle-side (T2/T3), where linearity is honest module
360	structure, and enters the count through
361	`nonempty_cotangentSpaceAddEquiv_of_finrank_eq`. -/
362	noncomputable def pointedDualNumberPointsEquivKer
363	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
364	    (G : (Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommGrpCat.{v})
365	    (rep : (G ⋙ CategoryTheory.forget CommGrpCat.{v}).RepresentableBy X)
366	    {e : Spec (CommRingCat.of k) ⟶ X.left}
367	    (he : e ≫ X.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :
368	    pointedDualNumberPoints X e
369	      ≃ {a : G.obj (Opposite.op (overDualNumber k)) //
370	          (G.map (overDualNumberZero k).op).hom a = 1} := by
371	  -- the constant tangent vector at `e`, whose restriction is the class of `e`
372	  have ha₀ : (G.map (overDualNumberZero k).op).hom
373	      (rep.homEquiv (overDualNumberAugment k ≫
374	        (Over.homMk e he : Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) ⟶ X)))
375	        = rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk e he : Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) ⟶ X) := by
376	    have h := (rep.homEquiv_comp (overDualNumberZero k)
377	      (overDualNumberAugment k ≫
378	        (Over.homMk e he : Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) ⟶ X))).symm
379	    rwa [← Category.assoc, overDualNumberZero_comp_augment, Category.id_comp] at h

/-!
# Affine two-chart covers, and their pullback along the base-change projection

An **affine two-chart cover** of a scheme `Y` (`Scheme.AffineTwoCover`) is a pair of affine
opens `V₀, V₁` covering `Y` whose overlap `V₀ ⊓ V₁` is again affine. This file provides:

* the structure `Scheme.AffineTwoCover`;
* **existence** for the challenge curve: the smooth, proper, geometrically irreducible curve
  `C/k` admits an affine two-chart cover (`Scheme.AffineTwoCover.nonempty_of_curve`), obtained
  as the preimages of the two standard charts of `ℙ¹` under a finite `k`-morphism `C ⟶ ℙ¹`
  (`exists_isFinite_toP1`, `AlgebraicJacobian.Curve.MapToP1`); the overlap is affine because it
  is the preimage of the affine chart overlap `D₊(X₀X₁)`;
* **stability under base change**: an affine two-chart cover of `C.left` pulls back, along the
  first projection `(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left ⟶ C.left`, to an affine two-chart cover of
  `(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left`, for any `k`-algebra `R` (`Scheme.AffineTwoCover.pullbackProd`).
  The key input is that the first projection is an affine morphism: it is the base change of
  `overSpec k R ⟶ Spec k` (itself affine, being a morphism between affine schemes) along
  `C.hom` (`Over.isAffineHom_fst_left`), and preimages of affine opens under an affine
  morphism are affine.

## Main declarations

* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineTwoCover` — the structure.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineTwoCover.nonempty_of_curve` — existence for the curve.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isAffineHom_fst_left` — the first projection of a base change along
  an affine morphism is affine.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineTwoCover.pullbackProd` — the pullback of an affine two-chart
  cover along the first projection `(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left ⟶ C.left`.
-/

     6	/-- A finite basic refinement of a pointed cover of a scheme: finitely many points and
     7	sections whose basic opens refine the cover at those points and still cover `X`.  The

    11	  ι : Type u
    12	  /-- The index type is finite. -/
    13	  [fintype : Fintype ι]

    15	  [decEq : DecidableEq ι]
    16	  /-- The chosen points. -/
    17	  pt : ι → X

    19	  r : ι → Γ(X, ⊤)
    20	  /-- Each basic open refines the cover at its point. -/
    21	  basicOpen_le : ∀ i, X.basicOpen (r i) ≤ 𝒰.opens (pt i)
